root_cause.text: In the `sev_ioctl_do_get_id2` function of the CCP crypto driver, the code omitted a check for the PSP command return status before invoking `copy_to_user`, permitting data transmission to userspace even when the firmware command failed due to invalid buffer sizes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (ret || WARN_ON_ONCE(argp->error)) goto e_free;` before the `copy_to_user` call in `drivers/crypto/ccp/sev-dev.c`, directly addressing the CVE description's report of KASAN slab-out-of-bounds errors occurring during `copy_to_user` when the firmware command fails.

vuln_statements.explanation: This copy_to_user call transmits sensitive SEV ID data to userspace without first checking if the PSP command returned successfully. According to the vulnerability root cause, the code omitted a check for the PSP command return status before invoking copy_to_user, permitting data transmission even when the firmware command failed due to invalid buffer sizes.
